questions.stem: What is the main consequence of habitat destruction for wildlife?

options.text: It causes animals to grow larger
It increases biodiversity in the area
It reduces biodiversity and can lead to species extinction
It has no significant effect on species

questions.explanation: Habitat destruction reduces biodiversity because organisms lose their homes, food sources, and breeding sites. Species that cannot adapt or move to new habitats may decline in number or become extinct. It is the leading cause of species loss worldwide.
